questions.q: In which year did Kuwait become independent from Britain?
questions.why: National Day is 25 February.

questions.q: Which family rules Kuwait?
questions.why: They have ruled since the 1750s.

questions.q: Which country invaded Kuwait in August 1990?
questions.why: A US-led coalition freed Kuwait in February 1991.

questions.q: What does Kuwait celebrate on 26 February?
questions.why: It marks the end of the Iraqi occupation.

questions.q: Before oil, what were Kuwait's main trades?
questions.why: Kuwaiti dhows sailed to India and Africa.

questions.q: In which year was oil discovered at Burgan?
questions.why: The Burgan field is one of the world's largest.

questions.q: Which landmark towers with blue-green spheres stand on Kuwait's coast?
questions.why: They opened in 1979.

questions.q: Which body, founded in 1963, is one of the Gulf's oldest elected parliaments?
questions.why: It has 50 elected members.

questions.q: In which year did Kuwaiti women win the right to vote?
questions.why: Four women were elected in 2009.

questions.q: What did retreating Iraqi forces set on fire in 1991?
questions.why: Over 600 wells burned for months.

questions.q: Which treaty of 1899 made Kuwait a British protectorate?
questions.why: Sheikh Mubarak the Great signed it.

questions.q: Which emir, called 'the Great', ruled from 1896 to 1915?
questions.why: He laid the foundations of modern Kuwait.

questions.q: Which emir led Kuwait to independence and its constitution?
questions.why: He is called the 'Father of the Constitution'.

questions.q: Which Kuwaiti emir was known as the 'Leader of Humanitarian Action'?
questions.why: The UN gave him the title in 2014.

questions.q: Which island off Kuwait has Hellenistic ruins from Alexander's time?
questions.why: The Greeks called it Ikaros.

questions.q: What is the capital of Kuwait?
questions.why: Most Kuwaitis live in its metro area.

questions.q: What is Kuwait's currency?
questions.why: It is the world's highest-valued currency unit.

questions.q: Which body of water lies off Kuwait's coast?
questions.why: Kuwait Bay cuts into the coast.

questions.q: Which spiced rice dish with meat is Kuwait's national dish?
questions.why: It is often made with chicken or fish.

questions.q: What is Kuwait's largest island?
questions.why: It is linked to the mainland by a bridge.

questions.q: Which countries border Kuwait?
questions.why: It is one of the world's smaller countries.

questions.q: What is a traditional Kuwaiti gathering room for men called?
questions.why: Politics and news are discussed there.

questions.q: Which old market in Kuwait City is a shopping landmark?
questions.why: It dates back over a century.

questions.q: Which skyscraper with a twisting shape is Kuwait's tallest?
questions.why: It is over 400 m tall.

questions.q: Which wooden boats were built at Kuwait's shipyards?
questions.why: The boom was a large trading dhow.

questions.q: Which bridge across Kuwait Bay is one of the world's longest?
questions.why: It opened in 2019.

questions.q: Which seafood is Kuwait especially famous for?
questions.why: Zubaidi, a pomfret, is a local favourite.

questions.q: Which Kuwaiti cultural centre is named after Sheikh Jaber?
questions.why: It opened in 2016.

questions.q: Which Kuwaiti shooter won Olympic gold in 2016 competing under the Olympic flag?
questions.why: Kuwait was suspended by the IOC at the time.

questions.q: Which Kuwaiti TV comedy legend starred in 'Darb Al-Zalaq'?
questions.why: He was one of the Gulf's most loved actors.
